disclaimer: Numerical evidence at finite lattice spacing and finite volume, statistical errors only, variational (upper) estimates. NOT a proof of the Yang-Mills mass gap.

autocorrelation.method: pooled FFT autocovariance about the global mean, Sokal window c = 5; tau_binning = B var(bin means) / (2 var)

formula_check.note: inserting E = sigma_L L - c/(2L) into the NG relation gives NG - Luscher = c^2 / (4 L^2 (2 sigma_L L^2 - c)) up to a term of second order in the difference (about c^2 / (8 sigma L^4)); c = pi (D-2)/3

ratios.note: glueball and torelon at the SAME fixed t, both from the same bootstrap / jackknife samples (correlations included)

rows.quantity: m/sqrt(sigma) NG at the pipeline's (t*_glue=1, t*_torelon=1)
m/sqrt(sigma) Luscher at the pipeline's (t*_glue=1, t*_torelon=1)
